decision_rule: Accept only when confidence >= confidence_threshold and top1_minus_top2 >= margin_threshold.
calibration_status: Historical validation at confidence 0.50 and margin 0.30 on 1,173 exported held-out plant predictions produced 96.85% coverage and 93.93% accepted-result accuracy. Current experimental threshold is confidence 0.60 with margin 0.30; it has not been evaluated on an independent calibration set or unsupported/non-leaf images.
